name: application-job-run-row
title: Job Run Row
description: ETL/pipeline job-run summary row with a status badge, duration, records-processed count, and a logs link — distinct from build-status-row, which shows a sequential CI stage-pill chain rather than a single run's throughput metrics.
useWhen: Listing recent ETL or batch job runs with their outcome and throughput.
You want records-processed counts formatted for readability at scale.
Each run should link out to its full logs.
avoidWhen: You need a sequential CI/CD stage chain (build→test→deploy) — use build-status-row instead.
You need a draggable node in a visual pipeline editor — use pipeline-flow-node instead.
There's no records-processed metric — a simpler status row is sufficient.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are full-width within their container; the job name truncates first to preserve the status badge, duration, record count, and logs link.
accessibility: Status is conveyed by both a distinct background/text color and a readable label (Succeeded/Running/Failed), never color alone.
The logs link uses descriptive link text ('View logs') rather than a bare icon.
Record counts use toLocaleString formatting for readability at scale.

variants.title: Job run row
variants.description: Three job runs (succeeded, running, failed) with real durations and formatted records-processed counts, on a light surface.
accessibility: Duration is formatted from real seconds via a shared formatDuration function, not hand-typed strings.

variants.title: Job run row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three job runs, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status badge colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
